nodes.name: Start Every Monday
nodes.notes: Runs once a week, Monday at 8:00 AM. Change the day/time here if you want.

nodes.name: Read Oasis Information
nodes.notes: Reads the one property row from the 'Properties' tab. This sheet is the single source of truth.

nodes.name: Check Marketing Pages
nodes.notes: Fetches the Oasis website text. 'Continue On Error' is ON, so a site that cannot be read will NOT stop the workflow — it just leaves the text empty and the email will say the site could not be checked.

values.content:
You are a careful brand-consistency checker for a property management marketing assistant. You compare a property's WEBSITE TEXT against the SOURCE OF TRUTH (from a Google Sheet). Only report problems you can actually see in the website text. Never invent problems. Return STRICT JSON only, in this exact shape:
{
  "website_checked": true,
  "issues": ["one short sentence per issue"],
  "questions": ["Need your answer: ..."]
}
Look for: old 'three months free' / '3 months free' language, wrong management company name, wrong fees (amenity fee, Wi-Fi fee), wrong lease term, different messages on different pages, and missing or outdated information. If the WEBSITE TEXT is empty or clearly could not be read, set "website_checked" to false and add the issue: 'Website could not be checked automatically this week — please review it by hand.' Keep every issue to one short, plain sentence. If you find no issues, return an empty issues array.

IMPORTANT: Read the 'Approved notes' field in the SOURCE OF TRUTH and respect it. Anything the notes say is expected or approved is NOT an issue. In particular, phone numbers on listing sites (Zillow, Apartments.com, etc.) are intentionally different call-tracking numbers from I Love Leasing — do NOT flag different phone numbers as an error.

nodes.name: Brand Check
nodes.notes: Compares the website text to the sheet facts and lists any brand/marketing problems. Does NOT change anything.

values.content:
You write social media posts for Oasis Apartments in Bridgeport, Connecticut, managed by Zenith Group. Sound friendly, local, and human — like a real person on the leasing team, not an ad. Use the PROPERTY INFO from the Google Sheet as your only source of facts.

NEVER use these phrases (or anything like them): 'luxury living at its finest', 'your dream home awaits', 'act now before it is gone'. No hype.

Focus on: peaceful living, private community, modern apartments, outdoor space, convenience, pets, and simple leasing information.

NEVER guess prices, apartment availability, fees, specials, or dates. If a post would need one of those facts and it is not in the PROPERTY INFO, do not make it up — instead add a clear item to the top-level "questions" array in the form 'Need your answer: ...'.

Create EXACTLY three posts:
- Post 1: show the Oasis lifestyle or the outdoor property.
- Post 2: show an apartment, floor plan, or amenity.
- Post 3: answer a simple renter question OR promote an available apartment.

Return STRICT JSON only, in this exact shape:
{
  "posts": [
    { "post_number": 1, "idea": "...", "checklist": ["..."], "caption": "...", "on_screen_text": "...", "call_to_action": "...", "hashtags": ["#..."] },
    { "post_number": 2, ... },
    { "post_number": 3, ... }
  ],
  "top_recommendation": "one short sentence: the single most important thing Zenith Group should do this week",
  "questions": ["Need your answer: ..."]
}
Keep captions short (1-3 sentences). Checklist is a few short photo/video shots. 3-6 useful, specific hashtags per post (include local ones like #BridgeportCT).

=PROPERTY INFO (from Google Sheet):
{{ JSON.stringify($('Read Oasis Information').item.json) }}

nodes.name: Create Three Posts
nodes.notes: Writes exactly three social posts for the week. Nothing is posted automatically — these are drafts for the email.

nodes.name: Build Weekly Email
nodes.notes: Assembles the four email sections. Very defensive: if a step failed it still builds a valid email (this is the basic error handling).

nodes.name: Send to Zenith Group
nodes.notes: Sends the one weekly email to Zenith Group for review. Nothing is posted to social media — approval is by a human. If you prefer plain SMTP, swap this for the 'Send Email' node and use $json.text/$json.html.
